title: feat(app-shell): Studio's action New menu opens on common actions, with the blank action under Advanced (part of objectui#11861)
body:
Part of #11861 — the actions entry only. The automations entry stays for a later claim, so the card stays open.

Clause-②: no

## What changes

In an object's **Actions** view, **New** used to add one action straight away: "New action", an update of this record with no field values yet (objectui#11820's skeleton). It now opens a menu, as the Validations view's does since objectui#11931:

| Preset | What it writes | When it is written |
|---|---|---|
| **Change a picklist field** | `operation: 'update'`, `params: [{ field }]` on the object's first author picklist, labelled "Change Status" for a Status field. The click asks for the new value and the platform writes it, as the caller. | At once. Disabled, saying "Needs a picklist field on this object.", when there is none the author may change. |
| **Run a flow** | `type: 'flow'` | Held until the editor's **Flow name** is given |
| **Open a web page** | `type: 'url'` | Held until the editor's **URL** is given |
| **Open a page in a dialog** | `type: 'modal'` | Held until the editor's **Modal / page name** is given |

The blank action is folded under **Advanced**, still named "New action", and it writes exactly what New wrote before (the same object literal, untouched). objectui#11820's `newActionPin` now clicks Advanced, then New action; it has no assertion changes.

Every preset starts from the blank action's seed: a fresh name, the "New action" label, this object, and `record_header` placement.

## A preset that needs a target waits for it

The spec refuses a `url`, `flow`, `modal`, `form` or `api` action without a `target`, and only the author knows which flow, address or page they mean. Such a preset is therefore **held in the panel**, the way a new validation rule waits for its condition (objectui#11820):

- It is listed with "Not saved — needs “Flow name”".
- The detail pane shows the Data pillar's held line (`engine.studio.held.line`, objectui#11786): "Not saved yet: the action “New action” needs “Flow name”. Your changes are kept here and saved once it is filled in."
- The target input is the **action editor's own** (`ActionDefaultInspector`, not edited). For a flow or a page it is a picker of the app's names, and free text when there are none.
- The first patch that gives the action a target writes it to the object draft. From then on it is an ordinary action.
- **Delete** drops it unsent.
- It stays on the object it was started on, and it never shows on another object's list.
- Known cost, the same as the validation hold: leaving the view or the object first drops it, and Publish does not wait for it.

**Which presets wait is decided by the action as it stands, not by a second list.** `heldInputKey` reads `TARGET_INPUT_KEYS`, the target-requiring types mapped to the editor's catalogue key for each target input. The keys are reused rows, so no new row was added for them. If the author switches a held action's Type to one without a target, the next patch writes it.

⛔ No preset writes a script (objectui#11921's ruling A).

## Why these four, and what is not offered

- **The objectui#11820 skeleton moved under Advanced** rather than becoming the first preset (the claim allows either). With an empty `patch` and no `params`, the platform answers a click with a refusal. "Change a picklist field" is the update a click can run as soon as it is written.
- **"Open a form" is not offered.** The spec's form target is the form view's name, written as the object name, a dot, and the view key. The editor's form picker lists `view` metadata names, and I did not verify that those are such keys. "Open a page in a dialog" targets a page, which the picker lists by name.
- **"Call an API endpoint" is not offered.** It needs both an endpoint and a request contract. It stays reachable from the blank action's Type control.

## The spec, measured rather than claimed

The runtime does not import `ActionSchema`. That keeps the schema out of the console's first load, for the same reason objectui#11921 writes out its body-key table. The two facts the module writes out are each re-derived from the spec in the new pin, `ObjectActionsPanel.presets-11861.test.tsx`:

- **Types that need a target.** For every `ActionType`, the action is held exactly when `ActionSchema` refuses it at `target`, and with a target nothing is held and nothing is refused there.
- **Field-name grammar for a param.** For eight names (`status`, `st`, `s`, `Status`, `_status`, `status_2`, `2status`, `sta-tus`), the picklist is offered exactly when the spec accepts it as `params.0.field`.

It also pins the class. Every preset in `ACTION_PRESETS` ends as an action that `ActionSchema` and `ObjectSchema` accept, the parse the object-draft save applies. For held presets that means after the author types the target into the **real** registered `ActionDefaultInspector`. The rest of the pin covers:

- the menu shape: 3 to 5 presets, and Advanced folded on every opening;
- the exact written shapes;
- picking a flow through the editor's picker;
- Delete;
- the object scoping;
- the disabled preset, which never takes a `system`, hidden or read-only picklist.

## Ablations

Run on head `67e28442c` through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode. Each anchor hit exactly once and moved 1 to 0. The blob changed, and each restore was proven: blob equal to HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` empty. The control run before them was 26 of 26 passing in the new pin.

| Guard removed | Pin result | What went red |
|---|---|---|
| The hold: `heldInputKey(fresh) === null` replaced by `true`, so every preset is written at once | 6 failed, 20 passed | the three held presets' spec parse; "Run a flow" is held; Delete drops it unsent; it stays on its object |
| `!f.system` in the picklist choice | 2 failed, 24 passed | "Change" asks for Status, not the platform's Sync State; the disabled row |
| `!f.readonly` | 1 failed, 25 passed | the disabled row: the read-only Stage was taken |
| the param-field grammar check | 5 failed, 21 passed | `s`, `Status`, `_status`, `2status`, `sta-tus` offered though the spec refuses them |
| the held list's object filter | 1 failed, 25 passed | a held action shows on another object |
| the `api` row of `TARGET_INPUT_KEYS` | 1 failed, 25 passed | the `api` parity case against `ActionSchema` |

The first round of the same six, on `ace58cbf1`, read identically.

## Gates

Every gate below ran on head `67e28442c` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD` after the last commit). The branch is cut from `main` at `d7e9e9ab6`.

**Tests**, under the container's verify lock, with repo-root `pnpm exec vitest run`:
- **The named set: 23 files, 348 tests passed.** It is the new pin, the objectui#11820 pin, every test naming `ObjectActionsPanel`, `ActionDefaultInspector` or `actionPresets`, the column-identity ratchet, and the three tests that read the designer table's source.
- **The whole `studio-design` directory: 147 files, 961 tests passed.**
- Lock verdict: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

**Type-check:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exited 0, after the dependency closure was built under the lock (`Tasks: 28 successful, 28 total`). `--listFiles` on the test project lists the new pin, the objectui#11820 pin and `actionPresets.ts`.

**Lint:** `pnpm exec eslint` on the 5 touched TS files: 0 errors, 0 warnings. The first commit drew two `react-hooks/preserve-manual-memoization` warnings; the second commit removed them.

**Other gates**, each with its own verdict line:

- `check:i18n-designer-parity`: 0. "Every en row has a zh row, and every shared row carries the same placeholders."

- `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:metadata-write-doors`: all 0.
- `check-changeset-presence`: 0. "5 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s): .changeset/11861-action-presets.md."

**Not measured:**

## Docs-driven rule

The Actions row of `content/docs/guide/console.md` does not describe **New** today, and that file is outside this claim's file list, so it is not edited here. Suggested sentence to append to that row: "The **New** menu opens on common actions in plain words (*Change a picklist field*, *Run a flow*, *Open a web page*, *Open a page in a dialog*); a flow, web-page or page action is saved once it has its target. The blank action is under **Advanced**." The `packages/app-shell/README.md` does not describe this menu.

## First-load bytes

The new designer-table rows are eager, as objectui#11937 measured, and the PM's note put the headroom at about 1.0 KB. So the copy is minimal: **10 new keys** (en and zh), down from 15 in the first commit.

- *Advanced* reuses the Validations menu's own row (`engine.studio.rules.advanced`).
- The blank action keeps its existing name row (`engine.studio.actions.newLabel`).
- The three presets that wait for a target carry no description line. Their labels say what they do, and the held line names the input once picked.
- The held line itself reuses `engine.studio.held.line`. The input names reuse the editor's own target-label rows.

As a local proxy, `gzip -9` of `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` grows by 322 B against the merge-base. That figure includes one source comment, which the build strips. The console build was not run locally, so **the budget bot's reading on this PR is the measurement**. If it reads over the ceiling, this PR stays a draft.

## Acceptance notes

- These are read-only observations, not filed (carrier: none for both):
  - The action editor's **Type** control writes `{ type }` alone. Switching an existing action to `url`, `flow`, `modal`, `form` or `api` composes a draft that `ActionSchema` refuses at `target`, and the Data pillar's hold (objectui#11786) does not cover actions. Measured only through the spec; not through a public entry.
  - The editor's `form` target picker lists `view` metadata names. Whether those are form view names in the spec's dotted form is unverified.
- No focus move into the editor's target input after a held preset. The Validations hold focuses its own condition group, but here the input belongs to the registered editor, and the held line names it instead.
